## 🔄 Upgrade Instructions

### Docker Users

```bash
docker pull kimikazee/qwopus:{VERSION}
docker stop qwopus
docker rm qwopus
docker run -d --name qwopus kimikazee/qwopus:{VERSION}
```

### pip Users

```bash
pip install --upgrade kimikazee-qwopus
# or
pip install kimikazee-qwopus=={VERSION}
```
